title: Export writes a set with the score's tempo, time signature and length
description:
As a producer, I want an exported set to open with the score's tempo, time signature and length, so that the DAW's grid is the score's grid.

```gherkin
Feature: Export a score as a DAW set
  Background:
    Given the sample "horn.wav" with a steady beat at 100 BPM
    And the score "tune.apr":
      """
      tempo 99.5
      time 3/4
      key F
      clip horn = horn.wav beats 0..3
      chords I IV . V
      track horn
      """

  Scenario: The set folder holds a set named after the score
    When I export "tune.apr" as a DAW set
    Then the export succeeds
    And the folder "tune Project" holds the set "tune.als"
    And the set is gzipped XML the DAW's format expects

  Scenario: Tempo and time signature
    When I export "tune.apr" as a DAW set
    Then the set's tempo is 99.5
    And the set's time signature is 3/4

  Scenario: The loop brace spans the piece
    When I export "tune.apr" as a DAW set
    Then the loop brace runs from bar 1 to the end of bar 4
    And looping is on

  Scenario: Exporting twice gives the same file
    When I export "tune.apr" as a DAW set twice
    Then both sets are byte-identical

  Scenario: The output can be named
    When I export "tune.apr" as a DAW set to "out/Mix.als"
    Then the folder "out" holds the set "Mix.als"
```
